Massive Fire Destroys Jakarta Revenue Agency Building

A large fire engulfed the Jakarta Revenue Agency building in Indonesia on Monday. The blaze caused extensive damage to the structure, with videos showing thick smoke billowing from the multi-story building. Fortunately, no casualties were reported in the incident. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation.
